name: Mailchimp
description: World leading email marketing & automation platform with pre-built e-commerce templates and Shopify integration.
fullDescription: Mailchimp is the benchmark marketing automation and email marketing platform for global e-commerce sellers. It features seamless synchronization with Shopify, WooCommerce, and custom webhooks, allowing sellers to set up abandoned cart recovery, automated post-purchase welcome flows, and intelligent customer lifetime value segmentation.
features: Pre-built e-commerce automation triggers (abandoned cart, order notifications)
Direct integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, and Zapier
Predictive demographics and smart customer lifetime value segmentation
AI creative assistant and automated product recommendation modules
Multi-channel campaign orchestration including email, SMS, and retargeting ads
